command:
set -eu
root=/tools/openssh
rm -rf "$root"
mkdir -p "$root/lib" "$root/usr/bin" "$root/usr/lib"
cp /lib/ld-musl-*.so.1 "$root/lib/"
cp /usr/lib/libcrypto.so.3 /usr/lib/libz.so.1 "$root/usr/lib/"
cp /usr/bin/ssh /usr/bin/scp /usr/bin/sftp "$root/usr/bin/"
loader=$(basename /lib/ld-musl-*.so.1)
for command in ssh scp sftp; do
  rm -f "/tools/$command"
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /tools/openssh/lib/%s --library-path /tools/openssh/usr/lib:/tools/openssh/lib /tools/openssh/usr/bin/%s "$@"\n' "$loader" "$command" > "/tools/$command"
  chmod 0555 "/tools/$command"
done
initContainers.name: install-openssh-client

command:
set -eu
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) target=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl; sha="9b9331644d0b6350030c521047490314b594591547b4ca28ef105b7adad73eb8" ;;
  aarch64|arm64) target=aarch64-unknown-linux-musl; sha="c7bf758ed864ef375ba3358d39b4d6e4b80da9e451b67a47ae1341df82c362e0" ;;
  *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
cli=/tmp/openshell-cli.tar.gz
curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors -o "$cli" \
  "https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/releases/download/v0.0.75/openshell-$target.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha" "$cli" | sha256sum -c -
rm -f /tools/openshell /tools/openshell.real
tar -xzf "$cli" -C /tools
mv /tools/openshell /tools/openshell.real
chmod 0555 /tools/openshell.real
cat > /tools/openshell <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
real=/tools/openshell.real
previous=
sandbox_name=
is_create=false
has_command=false
for argument in "$@"; do
  if [ "$previous" = sandbox ] && [ "$argument" = create ]; then
    is_create=true
  elif [ "$previous" = --name ]; then
    sandbox_name=$argument
  fi
  [ "$argument" = -- ] && has_command=true
  previous=$argument
done
if [ "$is_create" != true ]; then
  exec "$real" "$@"
fi
if [ -z "$sandbox_name" ]; then
  echo "openshell sandbox create requires --name" >&2
  exit 2
fi
log=/tmp/openshell-create-$$.log
if [ "$has_command" = true ]; then
  "$real" "$@" >"$log" 2>&1 &
else
  "$real" "$@" --no-tty -- true >"$log" 2>&1 &
fi
create_pid=$!
attempts=0
while [ "$attempts" -lt 180 ]; do
  if "$real" sandbox exec --name "$sandbox_name" -- true >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    wait "$create_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    rm -f "$log"
    exit 0
  fi
  attempts=$((attempts + 1))
  sleep 1
done
wait "$create_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
cat "$log" >&2
rm -f "$log"
echo "openshell sandbox create timed out waiting for SSH" >&2
exit 1
EOF
chmod 0555 /tools/openshell

plugin=/tmp/openshell-plugin.tar.gz
curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors -o "$plugin" \
  "https://registry.npmjs.org/@openclaw/openshell-sandbox/-/openshell-sandbox-2026.6.6.tgz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "1e0cbbcf105e931b6dc19c9411de73dcf65e76a111e3f41ffde379e8855caa33" "$plugin" | sha256sum -c -
rm -rf /openshell-plugin/*
tar -xzf "$plugin" --strip-components=1 -C /openshell-plugin
initContainers.name: install-openshell-assets
init-openshell-plugin
